description: Open source local inference engine. It runs models on the hardware you already have, whether that's a Mac, an NVIDIA or AMD GPU, or just a CPU. Plug it into Pi, OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw, Codex, Claude Code, Oh My Pi, and Cline.
